description: Close to tray and quit: the scoretable window (loaded from the built-in server on http://localhost) tells the app its tray texts and whether a match is in progress, says when its handler is gone (error screen), hides itself after the first-close notice, acknowledges a quit request, lists the scoresheet windows a quit closes too, quits after the scorer confirmed (or brings the hidden scoresheet windows back when they cancelled). LAN tablets and the scoresheet windows never get these commands.
